topography.project_purpose: Derivatives. Structurally: 50 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 34 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 17 common project-authored base contract(s) (ctokeninterface, ctokenstorage, cerc20interface). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
